answer: Escrow and a referral graph stop fake identities. A newcomer locks 50 units for 20 epochs and publishes its referrer, so accounts grow on a trellis, not alone on an island. Peers may dispute an identity in ten days; a proven fake loses its deposit and its referrer pays an equal fine, while the kernel of history stays intact. Faking 1000 identities costs 1000 x 50 = 50000 units, while one honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
